cards.ex: The company is going full throttle to meet the year-end deadline.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yil oxirigacha muddatga yetish uchun to'liq quvvat bilan ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: To'liq tezlikda yoki kuch bilan harakat qilish; maksimal harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I think they jumped the gun by announcing the product before it was ready.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, ular mahsulot tayyor bo'lishidan oldin e'lon qilib, oldindan boshlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtidan oldin harakat qilish; sabrsizlik bilan boshlash.

cards.ex: The project started strong, but it's starting to lose steam.
cards.exUz: Loyiha kuchli boshlandi, lekin u kuch yo'qota boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiziqish yoki energiya yo'qotish; sekinlashish.

cards.ex: His success as a singer was just a flash in the pan.
cards.exUz: Uning qo'shiqchi sifatidagi muvaffaqiyati shunchaki tez so'nish edi.
cards.uzDef: Tez paydo bo'lib, tezda yo'qoladigan narsa; qisqa muddatli muvaffaqiyat.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project by assigning tasks.
cards.exUz: Keling, vazifalarni belgilash orqali ushbu loyihani boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash; jarayonni ishga tushirish.

cards.ex: Traffic was moving at a crawl due to the accident.
cards.exUz: Yo'l-transport hodisasi tufayli harakat juda sekin edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin tezlikda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Now that I'm feeling better, I'm trying to make up for lost time at work.
cards.exUz: Endi o'zimni yaxshi his qilganimdan so'ng, ishda o'tkazib yuborilgan vaqtni to'ldirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: O'tkazib yuborilgan vaqtni qoplash uchun tezroq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The manager nipped the rumor in the bud before it could spread.
cards.exUz: Boshqaruvchi mish-mish tarqalishidan oldin uni yo'q qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlanishida to'xtatib qolish.

cards.ex: She hit the ground running in her new job and quickly impressed everyone.
cards.exUz: U yangi ishida darhol samarali bo'ldi va tezda hamma hayratda qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Darhol samarali va faol bo'lish.

cards.ex: You will receive the information in due course.
cards.exUz: Siz ma'lumotni o'z vaqtida olasiz.
cards.uzDef: Tegishli vaqtda; rejalashtirilgan vaqtda.

cards.ex: The train started to gather speed as it left the station.
cards.exUz: Poyezd stantsiyadan chiqib ketayotganda tezlikni ola boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Tezlikni oshirish; tezroq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The doctors are in a race against time to save the patient's life.
cards.exUz: Doktorlar bemorning hayotini saqlab qolish uchun vaqt bilan kurashmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt tugashidan oldin biror narsani qilishga urinish.

cards.ex: The ship moved dead slow in the fog.
cards.exUz: Kema tumanda o'ta sekin harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda sekin harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I've been on the go all day, running errands.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun davomida harakatda bo'ldim, turli ishlarni bajarib yurdim.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy harakatda yoki mashg'ul bo'lish.

cards.ex: Their relationship was a slow burn, starting as friends and gradually becoming more.
cards.exUz: Ularning munosabatlari asta-sekin rivojlandi, do'st sifatida boshlanib, asta-sekin ko'proq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Asta-sekin, vaqt o'tishi bilan rivojlanadigan narsa.

cards.ex: She was put on the fast track to management.
cards.exUz: U boshqaruvga tez yo'lda qo'yildi.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq rivojlanish yoki erishish yo'li.

cards.ex: The team went full tilt to win the championship.
cards.exUz: Jamoa chempionatda g'alaba qozonish uchun bor kuch bilan harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Maksimal kuch yoki tezlik bilan; to'liq kuch bilan.

cards.ex: We have several new projects in the pipeline.
cards.exUz: Bizda bir nechta yangi loyihalar rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan yoki tayyorlanayotgan; amalga oshirilishi kutilayotgan.

cards.ex: He's quick off the mark when it comes to solving problems.
cards.exUz: U muammolarni hal qilishda tezkor boshlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda harakat qilishni boshlash; tezkor javob berish.

cards.ex: Traffic came to a standstill due to the snowstorm.
cards.exUz: Qor bo'roni tufayli harakat to'xtab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: To'liq harakatlanmay qolish; to'xtab qolish.

cards.ex: The new marketing campaign is starting to gain traction.
cards.exUz: Yangi marketing kampaniyasi ommaviylashishni boshlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyat qozonish yoki ommaviylikni oshirish; taraqqiyotga erishish.

cards.ex: Let's keep the ball rolling and finish this project this week.
cards.exUz: Keling, ishni davom ettiraylik va bu loyihani shu hafta tugataylik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani davom ettirish; harakatda saqlash.

cards.ex: We're on track to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish rejasidamiz.
cards.uzDef: Rejaga muvofiq harakat qilish; rejalashtirilgan jadvalga rioya qilish.

cards.ex: The car started to pick up speed on the highway.
cards.exUz: Mashina avtomobil yo'lida tezlashni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Tezlikni oshirish; tezroq harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The race car hit top speed on the straightaway.
cards.exUz: Poyga mashinasi to'g'ri yo'lda eng yuqori tezlikka erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yuqori tezlikka erishish.

cards.ex: Step on it! We're going to be late!
cards.exUz: Gazni bos! Biz kech qolamiz!
cards.uzDef: Tezroq harakat qilish; tezroq yurish (mashina).

cards.ex: You can learn the language at your own pace.
cards.exUz: Siz tilni o'z tezligingizda o'rganishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy tezlikka mos ravishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The car was burning rubber as it sped away.
cards.exUz: Mashina tezlik bilan uzoqlashayotganda rezina yoqayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda harakat qilish; mashina g'ildiraklarini tez aylantirish.

cards.ex: We might consider expanding the team down the line.
cards.exUz: Biz kelajakda jamoani kengaytirishni ko'rib chiqishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, vaqt o'tgandan keyin.

cards.ex: With the funding secured, it's full steam ahead on the project.
cards.exUz: Mablag' ta'minlangandan so'ng, loyiha bo'yicha to'liq oldinga harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: To'liq tezlikda va qat'iyat bilan harakat qilish.
